content.rationale: S2-ifs (xquwmsts) splits graph-file access into four interfaces, each opened on the one repo root; this fixes the root they share. Holding the root once and opening every interface on it keeps the root singular — no interface re-decides where the repo lives — and holding no read or write reach of its own keeps the split real: the root holder resolves and lends the root, and each interface brings its own reach. M-layout (szmuyqrq) places the module flat at src/store.rs.
